requiredArtifacts: Connected-account and permission requirements without secret values
platformRules: Define exactly one grounded trigger followed by ordered actions; identify every source field and required destination field without inventing app events or fields.
Use a Filter when a non-match should stop the Zap and Paths when distinct outcomes need separate branches; record AND, OR, fallback and always-run semantics explicitly.
For every required field, identify its upstream value, a justified fallback or a filter/path guard so missing input cannot silently trigger an incorrect action.
List connected app accounts, scopes and ownership as placeholders only; never include credentials or claim an account is connected.
Add a bounded error-handling and run-history review plan for fallible actions, noting plan-dependent capabilities and replay limitations instead of assuming they are available.
Require explicit human approval before consequential actions and preserve the existing human approval boundary; a Zapier step or AI decision never grants authorization.
Produce a reviewable brief only. Do not run SDK or CLI commands, publish a Zap, connect an account or mutate Zapier.
